items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: We used to go out there and look at a fellow called... Billy Caillou, I believe it was.

ctx.x: Somebody told us they used to have balloons to go up. What do you have? I think it's part. Do you remember any of those?

Yeah, I remember the... We used to go out there and look at a fellow called... Billy Caillou, I believe it was. He used to go up in that balloon. Jump out that balloon. He had to go up there and then jump out that thing.
